name: RFE / NOID Response

phases.name: Document Collection & Review
steps: Email sent with the RFE/NOID quote and a brief description of each item
RFE/NOID meeting to discuss every item
Email sent with the list of required documents
Link for the upload-documents folders sent
Google Drive folder created per RFE item (organization + payments and translations)

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Draft explanation letter for every item in the RFE/NOID notice

phases.name: Execution
steps: Documents organized in order in the folders

phases.name: Finalization
steps: Response submitted (mail or online, if applicable)

pricing.notes: Pricing depends on who filed the ORIGINAL application, not a Standard/Plus split: $150 base + $60/item if SAES filed the original application; $250 base + $90/item if another party filed the original. $150 stored as the default (most common case, SAES's own prior client) — confirm which applies before quoting.
pricing.source: Real Saes Professional Services contract (Downloads/Contratos), extracted 2026-08-02.

standard_includes: RFE/NOID response letter based on 18 years of experience
Google Drive link for document uploads
